one_liner: Hyper-cheerful self-declared future Mile Queen who measures everything in miles and lives by her "MiRules".
personality: Bright, sporty and relentlessly upbeat, she runs her life on self-made "MiRules" (マイルール, a pun on "my rule"/"mile") and quantifies feelings in miles ("happiness at 100 miles"). Underneath the bubbliness she is proud and stubborn about proving milers are the strongest, and when off-form she gets quiet and blunt ("You're not someone who needs to be told, are you?"). She is open with her trainer, insists on sharing worries and complaints, and dreams of a "three-division conquest".

story_arc.summary: Aiming to be the true "Mile Queen", she goes from debut ("Genius miler") through the Asahi Hai FS, Oka Sho and an NHK Mile CS whose post-race title is "Bewildered by a phantom", then the Hanshin Cup, Takamatsunomiya Kinen ("Vow of master and pupil"), Yasuda Kinen ("I'm the strongest!"), Sprinters Stakes ("Toward a three-division conquest"), Tenno Sho (Autumn) and Mile CS. Her arc is about proving milers are the strongest and conquering sprint, mile and intermediate distances with her trainer.
story_arc.source: event titles; web check only gave minor details: https://umamusu.wiki/Gran_Alegria

timer_line_ideas: Oha-miiile! {user}, your independent run is done! MiRule: always check results right away. Shall we? Excitement at 100 miles!
Trainer-san... I mean {user}! The run's finished! Hehe, how many miles was that? Let's go look, and then a finishing salad. That's a MiRule!
